answer: Filling 100 aliases therefore needs 100 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the anchor record and indexed in the walnut history, the nadir audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 3 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
